description: 松本市: GTFS transit data is a dataset listed in Mobility Database, a catalogue of GTFS and GTFS Realtime transit feeds, published or maintained by 松本市. Public transport schedule data (routes, stops, trips and stop times in the General Transit Feed Specification) for Matsumoto, Nagano Prefecture, Japan. Coverage: Matsumoto, Nagano Prefecture, Japan. The Mobility Database lists 2 GTFS schedule feeds for this provider (Matsumoto, Nagano Prefecture, Japan). The schedule feeds declare these GTFS features: Fares V1, Feed Information, Headsigns, Location Types, Route Colors, Shapes, Translations. At least one feed is marked as published by the operator itself. Note in the listing: 信大横田循環線、横田信大循環線、浅間線、新浅間線、美ヶ原温泉線、北市内線、岡田線、アルプス公園線、鹿教湯温泉線、空港今井線、大久保工場団地線、山形線、寿台線、松原線、内田線、並柳団地線、四賀線 It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, accessibility and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-mobility-database-mobilitydata.
